subject: Field devices + consent language for Redwood booth
body:
--- Message 1/4 (original) ---
From: Everest Events <events@everest.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Field devices + consent language for Redwood booth

Hi Olga,

We’re finalizing logistics for the Everest summit next month and wanted to align on a couple items for the Redwood booth:

- What exact consent language should be shown on the badge scanner and on the QR lead form? We need something that covers marketing contact and product follow-up.
- Can the badge scanner push leads directly into our HubSpot instance (we’re on Enterprise)? If so, what fields do you need from our side?
- Any device onboarding checklist or certs we should collect from the vendor prior to the show?

Appreciate a quick runbook — show organizers asked for a copy by end of day Monday.

Thanks,
Lara V.
Event Producer, Everest Events
events@everest.com
(555) 322-8890

--- Message 2/4 ---
From: ScanFast Systems <support@scanfast.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Field devices + consent language for Redwood booth

Olga / Ben,

Thanks for looping us in. Short answers: yes, and yes. ScanFast devices can POST JSON or drop CSVs to an SFTP; we also support a direct HubSpot Webhook connector we've used for other shows. Outline below:

- Consent language: We recommend a two-line opt-in: "I agree to be contacted by Redwood Inference about product updates and event follow-ups." Include a link to your privacy center. The device UI supports a small disclaimer and a QR to view full text.
- Fields we capture by default: first_name, last_name, email, company, job_title, badge_id, scan_time, source_event. We can optionally capture phone and notes.
- Delivery options: (1) HubSpot webhook (OAuth) mapping, (2) SFTP CSV drops every 2 minutes, (3) Kafka / HTTP POST to your ingest endpoint.
- Security: devices use TLS1.3, signed firmware; we can provide cert thumbprints and a firmware manifest for your security team.

Attached: scanfast-integration-guide.pdf (device specs, sample payloads, firmware info).

If you want, we can run a 30-minute test flow next week to validate field names and opt-in rendering.

Best,
Samir Patel
Partner Ops, ScanFast Systems
support@scanfast.com
[Attachment: scanfast-integration-guide.pdf (PDF, 650KB)]

--- Message 3/4 ---
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Field devices + consent language for Redwood booth

Team — thanks, Samir. Quick plan to hand off to Everest and get vendor onboarding done:

1) Consent language: use ScanFast's recommendation but substitute Redwood branding and link to https://redwood.inference/privacy. Draft attached (consent_language_v2.docx). Laura, can you sign off on privacy/legal wording?
2) HubSpot mapping: we should prefer the HubSpot webhook so leads land in realtime. Ben — can you take point on mapping the fields to our lead routing? I’ve attached a starter CSV with required HubSpot properties.
3) Device certs and security: ask ScanFast to drop firmware manifest and cert thumbprints in Drive. Grace, can you confirm whether RDC (Redwood Dedicated customers) requires any additional PKI info?
4) Onboarding checklist: I built a simple checklist for site logistics and vendor contact points (event-onboarding-checklist.xlsx). We should send this to Everest and ScanFast after Laura's sign-off.

Next steps / timeline:
- Laura to confirm consent language by EOD Monday (9/13)
- Ben to produce final hubspot-field-mapping.csv by Tue (9/14)
- Schedule a vendor test with ScanFast for Wed (9/15) 10:00am PT

Thanks — we want to avoid any manual CSV drops during the show. Realtime ingestion keeps latency low.

Cheers,
Olga Petrov
Head of Events, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com
[Attachment: event-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 90KB)]

--- Message 4/4 (most recent) ---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 15:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Field devices + consent language for Redwood booth

All — quick status and confirmations after the legal review:

On consent wording (Laura + Legal): approved with one small edit (adds link to privacy center and an opt-out checkbox on the web form). Attached is the final consent doc.

HubSpot mapping: we’ll use webhook ingestion into HubSpot. Mapping file attached (hubspot-field-mapping.csv). Minimum required HubSpot properties: email, firstname, lastname, company, jobtitle, source_event (we’ll populate as "Everest Summit 2026"), and redwood_lead_origin (scanner vs qr-form). HubSpot integration team, please confirm OAuth client redirect URL: https://console.redwood.inference/hubspot/oauth/callback

Device onboarding: ScanFast — please upload the firmware manifest and cert thumbprints to the shared drive folder (link below) and confirm the SNI on device TLS certs. We will run the test on Wed 9/15 10:00am PT — meeting invite to follow.

Related links: HubSpot ticket RED-4721 (for OAuth / scopes) and onboarding folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_onboarding_docs

Attachments: hubspot-field-mapping.csv, consent_language_v2.docx

Ben Carter
Senior Field Ops, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123
